label: Building the Maxwell matrix
subgoals: Put ground plus all couplings on the diagonal
Put minus each coupling off the diagonal
Mirror the entries to keep the matrix symmetric

label: Ground capacitance from row sums
subgoals: Sum each row of the Maxwell matrix
Read the row sum as the ground capacitance
Negate the off-diagonal entries to read the couplings

label: Charge from the matrix
subgoals: Multiply each matrix entry in the row by its conductor voltage
Sum the products to get the charge
Cross-check with ground and coupling charges separately
